title: ElevenLabs Models Explained: Eleven v4, v3, Multilingual v2 and Flash
desc:
ElevenLabs has six speech models plus dedicated models for transcription, music and sound effects. This episode compares Eleven v4, v4 Turbo, v3, v3 Conversational, Multilingual v2 and Flash v2.5, explains what changed in Eleven v4, shows the character limits and concurrency per plan, and gives the docs' model pick for each use case.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
